name: claudemaxxing
description: Codex workflows and lifecycle gates for the claudemaxxing orchestration harness.

interface.shortDescription: Sol-first planning and governed Codex delegation.
interface.longDescription: Plans nontrivial Codex work with GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra before optional fan-out, while preserving diverse-ideas, session persistence, and verifier-gated self-improvement workflows over the deterministic core.
defaultPrompt: For a broad or multi-deliverable request, use $claudemaxxing:gauntlet first to divide it into incremental parts; each part then follows normal routing.
Use $claudemaxxing:solplan first for nontrivial unplanned work.
After root review, use $claudemaxxing:fanout only for independent implementation chunks.
